groups.title: 104th Top 10 Graduates
groups.def: The ten cadets ranked highest at the 104th Training Corps (Southern Division) graduation ceremony, as shown on screen.

groups.title: 104th Cadets
groups.def: Cadets who trained in and graduated from the 104th Training Corps' Southern Division (Eren, Mikasa and Armin's class): its top ten plus Armin, Ymir and Floch. Their commandant Keith Shadis doesn't count (he was the instructor, not a cadet), nor does anyone from another class or division.

groups.title: Original Levi Squad
groups.def: The first lineup of Levi's Special Operations Squad, shown before and during the Female Titan arc: Levi, his hand-picked Eld, Gunther, Oluo and Petra, and Eren, who was placed in the squad when he joined the Survey Corps. The later Levi Squad lineups (Mikasa, Armin, Jean, Connie, Sasha, Historia from Season 3) don't count.

groups.title: Ackerman Family
groups.def: Named members of the Ackerman bloodline in the anime: Kenny, his sister Kuchel (named in ep. 47), her son Levi, and Mikasa (an Ackerman through her father). The family's other members (Kenny's grandfather, Mikasa's parents) are unnamed and not in the bank. Level 1 because every tile shows the surname.

groups.title: Inherited a Non-Founding Titan
groups.def: Characters shown in the anime inheriting (holding, at any point) one of the eight Titans other than the Founding Titan, whether or not they also held the Founding Titan: Eren (Attack, War Hammer), Grisha and Eren Kruger (Attack), Reiner (Armored), Bertholdt and Armin (Colossal), Annie (Female), Tom Ksaver and Zeke (Beast), Pieck (Cart), and Marcel, Ymir, Porco and Falco (Jaw). Founding-only holders (Ymir Fritz, Karl Fritz, Uri, Frieda) don't count, nor does only ever being a mindless Pure Titan (Dina, Rod, Pixis and Nile after Zeke's scream, Jean, Connie and Gabi at Fort Salta in the finale). Avoids Founding Titan Holders: the two split one list of Titan holders.

groups.title: Founding Titan Holders
groups.def: Characters shown in the anime holding the Founding Titan: its origin Ymir Fritz (the Founder, listed as its first holder), Karl Fritz, Uri and Frieda Reiss, then Grisha (who took it from Frieda) and Eren. Rod and Uri's father holds it too but is unnamed; Rod, Historia, Dina and Zeke have royal blood but never held it.

groups.title: Royal Blood
groups.def: Characters the anime identifies as blood members of the royal Fritz line or its Reiss branch: Karl Fritz, Rod, Uri, Frieda and Historia Reiss, Dina Fritz and her son Zeke. Grisha and Eren Yeager have no royal blood, and Mikasa's lineage (Hizuru's Shogun clan, via her mother) isn't the Fritz royal line. Ymir Fritz is the line's ancestor through the king, not a blood member (the anime wiki lists her as a 'political member'), so every group that deals her tile avoids this one.

groups.title: Marleyan Warriors
groups.def: Members of Marley's Warrior program (titan shifters and candidates) shown in the anime, including Tom Ksaver, the Beast Titan before Zeke. Eren Kruger (a Marleyan officer and Restorationist spy) and Grisha were never Warriors.

groups.title: Survey Corps Commanders
groups.def: Characters who served as Commander of the Survey Corps at some point in the anime.

groups.title: Garrison Regiment
groups.def: Characters the anime shows serving as Garrison soldiers: Commander Dot Pixis, Captain Hannes, and squad leaders Rico Brzenska and Ian Dietrich. Floch is not counted even though the anime wiki lists him as briefly ex-Garrison (one line in ep. 48); this group avoids both groups that deal Floch so he never shares its board. Premier Zackly (over all three regiments) and the cadets attached to Ian's squad at Trost (Eren, Mikasa) don't count.

groups.title: Surnames That Are Common Words
groups.def: Characters whose displayed surname is, on its own, a common English word: Blouse, Hoover (to vacuum), Springer (the spaniel), Finger, Smith and Jinn (genies). Every other surname in the bank is not a common word (Galliard is a rare old dance, Grice and Bott are obscure; Zackly, Pixis, Forster, Braun, Reiss, Yeager, Ksaver etc. aren't words). Fritz only exists in the idiom 'on the fritz', so to keep it off the board this group avoids every group that deals a Fritz tile (Founding Titan Holders, Royal Blood, Women Who Held a Titan, Share a First Name).

groups.title: Titan Shifters of the 104th
groups.def: Graduates of Eren's 104th class (Southern Division) shown in the anime holding one of the Nine Titans at some point: the hidden shifters Reiner, Bertholdt, Annie and Ymir, plus Eren and Armin (who inherited the Colossal Titan openly in Shiganshina - the old title 'Secret' didn't fit him). Jean and Connie, turned into mindless Pure Titans at Fort Salta in the finale, never held one of the Nine and don't count.

groups.title: Warriors Sent to Paradis (845)
groups.def: The four Warriors Marley sent to infiltrate Paradis Island in the year 845, starting the Paradis Island Operation.

groups.title: Regiment Commanders
groups.def: Characters who commanded the Walls' regiments in the anime: Survey Corps Commanders Keith, Erwin, Hange and Armin, Garrison Commander Dot Pixis, Military Police Commander Nile Dok, and Premier Darius Zackly, commander-in-chief of all three regiments. Captains (Levi, Kenny, Hannes), squad leaders (Rico, Ian), field officers like Jean, Yeagerist leader Floch, the monarchs (Rod, Historia) and Zeke (War Chief of Marley's Warriors, not a regiment) don't count.

groups.title: Alive at the Finale
groups.def: Characters still alive when the anime ends (Final Season finale, including its epilogue): Mikasa, Armin, Jean, Connie, Levi, Reiner, Annie, Pieck, Falco and Gabi, plus Historia and Rico (seen in the epilogue three years after Eren's death). Everyone else in this bank dies on screen or before the story begins - e.g. Pixis and Nile (turned into Pure Titans in ep. 78, killed in ep. 81), Keith (blows up a Marleyan cruiser with Magath, ep. 86), Hange (Final Chapters Special 1), Zeke and Eren at the very end.

groups.title: Scouts Who Survived Shiganshina (850)
groups.def: The nine Survey Corps soldiers who survived the 850 battle to retake Shiganshina District (Season 3 Part 2) and were honoured in the medal ceremony: Levi, Hange, the recruit Floch, and the Levi Squad members Eren, Mikasa, Armin (revived by the Titan injection), Jean, Connie and Sasha. Not Erwin (killed in the charge), not Historia (queen by then, not there), not the Warriors who fought there and escaped (Reiner, by then no longer a Scout, Zeke, Pieck), and not the 845 fall of Shiganshina (the year in the title rules out Scouts such as Keith and Erwin who lived through that one).

groups.title: Jaw Titan Holders
groups.def: Everyone shown holding the Jaw Titan in the anime: Marcel Galliard, then Ymir (who ate him), then his brother Porco (who ate her), then Falco (who ate Porco). Ymir Fritz held the original power the Nine Titans split from, not the Jaw Titan itself.

groups.title: Women Who Held a Titan
groups.def: Female characters shown in the anime holding one of the Nine Titans: Annie (Female), Pieck (Cart), Ymir (Jaw), Frieda (Founding) and Ymir Fritz (the Founder, listed as the first Founding Titan holder). Being turned into a mindless Pure Titan doesn't count: not Dina, not Gabi (a candidate who never inherited, only briefly turned by the smoke at Fort Salta in the finale), and not Historia (who refused to inherit). Lara Tybur (War Hammer) isn't in this bank.

groups.title: Share a First Name
groups.def: Characters whose first name is shared by another character in this bank: Eren Yeager and Eren Kruger (Grisha named his son after Kruger), and the 104th's Ymir and the Founder Ymir Fritz. No other first name repeats among the bank's names.

groups.title: First Names That Are Common Words
groups.def: Characters whose displayed first name is, on its own, a common English word: Dot, Rod, Colt, Jean (the cloth) and Tom (a male cat). Every other first name in the bank is not a common word: Eld (archaic for 'old age') and Marcel (an obscure hair wave) are rare dictionary words, Nile is a proper noun, Levi, Porco, Falco, Rico and Historia aren't English, and the rest aren't words.
